segments: Let's go over the notification service migration.
We decided to replace the cron job with a message queue.
The queue will be RabbitMQ because ops already runs it.
Notifications must be delivered within thirty seconds.
Every notification must be retried at least three times on failure.
There's a risk that duplicate messages spam users during the cutover.
We still don't know who owns the dead letter queue.
Action item: write a consumer with idempotency keys.
